2609.31619.title: Learning to Stop without Learning to Stop: Self-Supervised Confidence Training Improves Reasoning Efficiency
2609.31619.paper_summary: Reasoning models often generate very long reasoning traces, making inference computationally expensive. Existing approaches typically improve efficiency either through inference-time early-stopping mechanisms or by explicitly encouraging shorter reasoning during training, for example through reinforcement learning with length penalties. We show that substantial efficiency gains can instead emerge from a different kind of supervision: \textit{confidence}. Using a self-supervised procedure, we fine-tune reasoning models to predict their confidence in the answer at intermediate points along their own reasoning trajectories using only 600 training problems. Confidence is used only as a training target: the loss contains no objective for reasoning length, efficiency, or stopping. At inference, the fine-tuned models use the standard generation procedure, with no confidence elicitation or early-stopping mechanism. Despite this, self-supervised confidence fine-tuning makes reasoning more efficient, reducing generated tokens by up to 25\% at matched accuracy across Gemma, Qwen, Nemotron, and GPT-OSS models on mathematical, scientific, and coding reasoning benchmarks, with efficiency gains comparable to methods that explicitly optimize for shorter reasoning. Analysis of reasoning episodes further shows that confidence supervision largely preserves the base models' high-level reasoning composition rather than selectively suppressing particular behaviors. Our results suggest that efficient reasoning may emerge as a downstream consequence of learning metacognitive signals, without being directly optimized.
2609.31619.paper_summary_zh: 推理模型通常會生成非常長的推理痕跡，使得推理計算成本高昂。現有的方法通常通過推理時的提前停止機制或在訓練過程中明確鼓勵更短的推理來提高效率，例如通過帶有長度懲罰的增強學習。我們展示了可觀的效率增益可以來自另一種監督方式：\textit{信心}。使用自我監督程序，我們微調推理模型，以預測它們在自己的推理軌跡中間點的答案信心，僅使用600個訓練問題。信心僅用作訓練目標：損失函數中不包含推理長度、效率或停止的目標。在推理時，微調後的模型使用標準生成程序，沒有信心引導或提前停止機制。儘管如此，自我監督的信心微調使推理變得更高效，根據數學、科學和編碼推理基準，在Gemma、Qwen、Nemotron和GPT-OSS模型上，生成的標記數量減少了多達25\%，而準確性保持一致，效率增益可與明確優化更短推理的方法相媲美。對推理過程的分析進一步顯示，信心監督在很大程度上保留了基礎模型的高級推理組合，而不是選擇性地抑制特定行為。我們的結果表明，高效推理可能作為學習元認知信號的下游結果出現，而不是直接被優化。
